title: Gate count bound for circuit rewriting
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, let $Q$ be a predicate on gate kinds and input counts, and let $P$ be a property of gates. Suppose a rewriting procedure replaces each gate satisfying $Q$ by a gadget that extends the existing acyclic gate list, preserves that gate's value for every input assignment, and returns a valid output vertex. Require also that the gadget's gate list has length at most the original list length plus the gate's number of inputs plus $2$, that its output depth is at most $c$ plus the maximum depth of the gate's input vertices, and that every added gate satisfies $P$. If every gate of $C$ satisfies $Q$, then the rewritten circuit has at most $\sum_{g\in G} (|\operatorname{args}(g)|+2)$ gates, where $G$ is the gate list of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n input vertices
the rewriting procedure satisfies the stated gadget guarantee for every acyclic prefix and eligible gate
every gate in C satisfies Q
